  "endpoints_animal": [
    "hERG assay",
    "conscious non-rodent telemetry cardiovascular",
    "rodent central nervous system (modified Irwin or FOB)",
    "respiratory function (plethysmography)"
  ],
  "endpoints_human": [
    "first clinical entry"
  ],
  "endpoint_class": "not-stated",
  "concordance_definition": "The study evaluated the utility of the core battery of safety pharmacology studies in supporting first-in-human clinical entry of small molecule drug candidates. It assessed whether findings from these animal studies had an impact on the safety/risk assessment of the drug and its progression into the clinic.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "The evaluation only looked at safety pharmacology testing from compounds that entered clinical development but did not assess whether such testing contributed to terminating drug candidates.",
    "The actual number of non-rodents used for a cardiovascular study can be limited by re-use for further compounds from a colony implanted with telemetry devices.",
    "ECGs collected in a repeat dose toxicity study are usually \"snapshots\" obtained from manually restrained animals over a short timeframe, which can affect data quality.",
    "The study did not assess concordance from in vivo cardiovascular safety pharmacology testing to effects seen in the clinic.",
    "The study did not assess whether the GLP safety pharmacology studies added any substantial new information about the safety profile of the drug candidate.",
    "The study did not assess whether the findings from the neurofunctional assessments in rodent Irwin/FOB testing predicted common Phase I adverse events.",
    "The study did not assess whether the findings from plethysmography testing predicted clinical respiratory findings.",
    "The study did not assess whether the findings from the hERG assay correlated with animal data or clinical outcomes.",
    "The study did not assess whether the findings from telemetry study evaluation had good concordance for detecting heart rate and blood pressure findings in the clinic."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "105 small molecule drug candidates evaluated for first clinical entry.",
    "Core battery studies included hERG, non-rodent telemetry cardiovascular, rodent CNS, and respiratory function.",
    "21% of rodent CNS studies (modified Irwin or FOB) had findings.",
    "28% of rodent respiratory studies (plethysmography) had findings.",
    "None of the CNS or respiratory findings were identified as of obvious concern to moving drugs into the clinic.",
    "About 10% of studies showed effects on QTc interval in telemetry testing.",
    "Telemetry study findings sometimes resulted in a lower clinical starting dose and/or increased awareness for cardiovascular effects in Phase I.",
    "hERG assay alone is not particularly sensitive in predicting proarrhythmic risk.",
    "Routine use of rodent CNS and respiratory function testing appears to have limited utility.",
    "Overhaul of the current \"box ticking\" core battery approach is suggested.",
    "94% of packages included a conscious non-rodent telemetry study.",
    "60% of telemetry studies used Beagle dogs, 37% used cynomolgus monkeys.",
    "61% of telemetry studies showed no effect on cardiovascular function.",
    "39% of telemetry studies showed changes in cardiovascular function.",
    "9 occasions showed higher/high dose changes in blood pressure only.",
    "6 occasions showed ECG [interval change/s] only.",
    "9 occasions showed prolonged QTc interval.",
    "88% of packages included a modified Irwin test or FOB for CNS assessment.",
    "78% of CNS studies showed no effect.",
    "83% of packages included plethysmography testing for respiratory function.",
    "78% of respiratory function studies showed no effect.",
    "10% of packages included a gastrointestinal motility study.",
    "39% of compounds showed an effect on cardiovascular function in telemetry testing.",
    "27% of compounds with hERG IC50 <10 μM showed a higher dose level increase in QTc interval.",
    "6 compounds with hERG IC50 >10 to >30 μM showed increased QTc interval.",
    "1 compound with hERG IC50 <0.1 μM showed no effect on cardiovascular function in dog telemetry study.",
    "8 compounds showed ECG changes in non-rodent toxicity testing out of 30 showing an effect in telemetry.",
    "6 toxicity studies showed changes in ECG parameters not reported in telemetry.",
    "4 compounds showed high dose histopathology changes in the heart during non-rodent toxicity testing.",
    "26% of candidate drugs were eliminated from development based on single dose safety pharmacology cardiovascular study findings (never).",
    "27% of candidate drugs were eliminated from development based on single dose safety pharmacology cardiovascular study findings (rarely).",
    "27% of candidate drugs were eliminated from development based on single dose safety pharmacology cardiovascular study findings (occasionally).",
    "5% of candidate drugs were eliminated from development based on single dose safety pharmacology cardiovascular study findings (frequently)."
  ]
}
